title: Lizardo, "Patriotism as a Choice Process: National Pride After 9/11" (Social Psychology Quarterly, forthcoming)
paper: Omar Lizardo, Patriotism as a Choice Process: National Pride After 9/11, Social Psychology Quarterly, forthcoming
cost_basis: GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04 runner, free for public repositories (a comparable 4 vCPU cloud machine is about 0.20 USD an hour)

environment_commands.cmd: Rscript -e 'print(sessionInfo()); for (p in c("renv","gssr","dplyr","survey","modelsummary")) cat(p, tryCatch(as.character(packageVersion(p)), error=function(e) "not installed"), "\n")'

setup.cmd: sudo apt-get install -y -q libcurl4-openssl-dev libssl-dev libxml2-dev libfontconfig1-dev libharfbuzz-dev libfribidi-dev libfreetype6-dev libpng-dev libtiff5-dev libjpeg-dev >/dev/null; Rscript -e 'install.packages("renv", repos="https://cloud.r-project.org"); renv::restore(prompt = FALSE)'

scope_notes: The README's full pipeline. Data are the GSS 1996 and 2004 files fetched from NORC at run time, so a difference can come from a revised GSS file as well as from code or versions.
Figures are compared by hash only; PDF metadata alone changes a hash.
